## Items

### [CMRL] 🚇 Phase 2 first stretch opens Oct 11
- 14.6 km Poonamallee Bypass–Vadapalani via Porur, Phase 2's first operational stretch, to be inaugurated by PM Modi on Oct 11.
- CRS clearance came only in May 2026 — a ready line sat shut ~7 months (TOI: inauguration was delayed amid assembly elections; CMRL wanted a PM launch).
- Sources: New Indian Express, Sep 26, 2026 — https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/tamil-nadu/2026/Sep/26/pm-modi-to-launch-first-14-km-of-chennai-metros-phase-ii-on-oct-11 ; The Hindu, Sep 25, 2026 — https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/pm-modi-likely-to-inaugurate-poonamallee-vadapalani-phase-ii-metro-rail-stretch-on-october-11/article71508771.ece
- Context (X): 11 of 17 stations initially, 6 later (Saligramam, Avichi School, Alwarthirunagar, Valasaravakkam, Karambakkam, Alapakkam) — @UpdatesChennai; network 54 km → ~69 km — @rajeshamlw.

### [SR] 🚉 Beach–Tambaram midnight locals cancelled 8 nights
- Southern Railway Chennai Division: maintenance at Guindy station, 12:15–2:45 am, Sep 27–Oct 4.
- Beach 11:59 pm EMU cancelled Sep 26–Oct 3; Tambaram 8:45 pm cancelled Sep 26, 28–30, Oct 1–3; Tambaram 11:40 pm cancelled Sep 27.
- Source: DT Next, Sep 25, 2026 (updated 8:31 pm) — https://www.dtnext.in/news/chennai/chennai-beach-tambaram-midnight-trains-to-be-cancelled-for-8-days-from-september-27
